title: Moment Maps and Lattice Functions
body_html:
Moment Maps and Lattice Functions

Let \(L\) and \(L'\) be self-dual lattice functions on \(V\) and \(V'\), and let \(B=L\otimes L'\) on \(W=V\otimes_D V'\). Then:

  • the jumps of \(B\) are sums of jumps of \(L\) and \(L'\);
  • \(B\) is self-dual;
  • under \(W\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_D(V,V')\), \(B_r\) consists of maps sending \(L_s\) into \(L'_{s+r}\);
  • \(M(B_r)\subseteq \mathbf g_{L,2r}\) and \(M'(B_r)\subseteq \mathbf g'_{L',2r}\).
proof_html: The proof combines the tensor-product norm formula with adjoint compatibility. The factor \(2r\) in the target filtrations comes from composing a map of lattice degree \(r\) with its adjoint.

deps.title: Moment Maps for a Classical Type I Dual Pair
